title: Compliance.ComplianceScreening.Screened.v1 data
description: Payload of Compliance.ComplianceScreening.Screened.v1. Ids, the decision and reason codes only. The inputs to screening (sanctions, PEP and KYC flags, amount) are not published; entitled readers get them through the compliance API.

screeningId.description: Screening id, `CMP-` followed by a UUID (same as aggregateId).

transactionId.description: Id of the screened transaction, as given by the caller.

customerId.description: Customer id (an identifier, not personal data).

reasons.description: Rule reason codes, for example SANCTIONS_HIT, KYC_NOT_VERIFIED, PEP_HIGH_VALUE_REVIEW, COMPLIANT. Restricted data: consumers must be entitled to read it. Consumers must accept codes they do not know.
